rollupMode.label: Parent Totals
rollupMode.description: How a parent row's amount relates to its children

options.label: Computed - parent amount is the sum of its children
Own + children - parent's own amount is added to its children's sum
Budget cap - parent amount is an allocation, children are shown against it

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Ordered column visibility, edited by the Columns tab rather than as a schema field

currency.label: Currency Code
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used to format amounts, e.g. USD, JMD

locale.label: Locale
locale.description: Locale used to format amounts, e.g. en-US, en-JM. Leave blank to use the system default.
